2021 Trek FX 3 Disc Hybrid Bike – Size Medium – £450

Great all-round hybrid bike, ideal for commuting, fitness rides, or weekend paths. Well looked after and ready to ride.

Key details:
• Model: Trek FX 3 Disc (2021)
• Frame size: Medium
• Serviced in March
• New tyres fitted in June

Condition notes:
Overall in good working order with recent maintenance and fresh tyres. In the interest of full honesty, there is a small tear on the saddle and the gears can be a bit clunky when it’s cold (likely just needs a minor cable/indexing tweak).

Asking £450 – sensible offers considered. Collection only; message if you’d like to arrange a viewing.
